elements_selected.content: `zetl cap emergency-shutdown` per REQ-3431 (BUG-024 resolution). Produces a printable operator checklist: (1) remove/redirect DNS; (2) CDN purge/delete `/c/*`; (3) rotate secrets (new `zetl cap genkey`); (4) announce to readers; (5) re-enrol when ready. NOT automated — documentation-generation only. Spec has no cryptographic kill-switch.
